name: SSX_CAM_v1
note: Locked Sunsex camera. Matches the C4D preset in 100 DAY RACE/1-2. Orthographic stands in for the very long lens.

moves.note: Only zoom and pan ever move, always eased. 1x = the px_per_meter framing. The bake always renders at 1x.

room.walls: data in ssx_profiles.room.walls: { edge: [i, j, 'x' | 'z'], height }. Default: the two back edges as backdrops.
room.backdrop_note: height 'backdrop' = tall enough to pass the top of the screen at 1x, computed from the frustum.

light.note: One sun: infinitely far, same direction everywhere, no falloff. Azimuth turns it around the room (0 = from +x, 90 = from +z), elevation lifts it (90 = straight down). Brightness = ambient + sun * cos(angle to the face), scaled so the floor at these defaults is exactly floor.color. Live sliders at ?debug=cam.

avatar.anchor_note: Ground point = center of the footprint between the ankles, 25 px above the lowest toe/shadow pixel (900). Align new avatars with public/avatars/avatar_template.png.

shadow.note: 3D floor shadow under generated avatars (presets keep their baked one).
